subject.title: perf(state): cap the per-agent SQLite handle cache with LRU eviction

question: Is `openOpenClawAgentDatabase` contractually limited to synchronous, non-retained use everywhere, or must the cache use an explicit acquire/release or idle-handle lifecycle before eviction can close handles?
rationale: The answer determines whether closing an LRU entry is safe for existing callers and cannot be inferred solely from the transaction-depth guard or the supplied serial cache tests.

options.title: Use explicit idle ownership
options.body: Track active leases or refactor access through a bounded helper so eviction closes only handles that no caller can still use.

options.title: Prove synchronous-only use
options.body: Retain the current design only after exhaustive caller proof and a regression test that establishes no returned handle survives an eviction-triggering operation.

recommendation.title: Use explicit idle ownership
recommendation.body: Track active leases or refactor access through a bounded helper so eviction closes only handles that no caller can still use.

likelyOwner.reason: The current proposal defines the cache-lifetime invariant and is the most direct owner for clarifying or revising it.
